brief:
Google Maps satellite imagery showing extensive destruction across Gaza circulated widely on social media and in news articles this week. The images depict what appear to be entire neighbourhoods reduced to rubble, including areas in the southern city of Rafah, according to Bellingcat.

Claims about a Google imagery update prompted the wide sharing of the photographs across social media platforms and in news reporting.
dek: Earlier this week, several viral social media posts and news articles stated that Google had updated satellite imagery over Gaza. The imagery shared in these posts and articles shows several areas, including the southern city of Rafah. title: Google satellite images reveal Gaza destruction across multiple cities
